declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The parties reached this settlement through negotiations. Because those discussions were confidential mediation communications, I do not recount the offers or exchanges. The agreement provides a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically to identifiable members without a claims process. Brightline will separately pay up to $3 million in court-approved fees and expenses; it has not agreed to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any amount not awarded will go to the class. The fund represents 50% of the $64 million in disputed charges. In my judgment, this substantial, direct recovery is fair in light of the significant certification risk, the risk of losing at trial, and the years required to reach trial. Counsel's compensation is fixed regardless of the outcome, and any awarded fee goes to the funding foundation, not the firm.
